name: triage
description: Read a backlog (Linear, GitHub, PRs, or a list), categorize, prioritize, and route each item to the right verb.

steps.name: Read backlog
steps.instruction: Auto-detect backlog source from CLAUDE.md (Linear workflow section, GitHub issues config) or accept a user-provided list. Parse issues, PRs, or items. For each: extract title, description, labels, status, assignee.
checklist: Items parsed with title, description, labels

steps.name: Categorize
steps.instruction: For each item: categorize as feature, bug, tech debt, or question. Extract acceptance criteria if present. Note dependency links between items.

steps.name: Enterprise cross-reference
steps.instruction: Cross-reference backlog against endpoint registry: uncovered 'in' endpoints are implicit high-priority items. Check scope docs for items that may conflict with scope protection. Check parity systems (entity registries, endpoint maps) for uncovered entities.
checklist: Parity gaps surfaced (if parity system exists)

steps.name: Prioritize
steps.instruction: Rank items by: blocking status (blockers first), dependency order (prerequisites before dependents), severity, age. For migration projects: route migration screens to /tdd with port-checklist as reference.
checklist: Items ranked by blocking status, deps, severity, age
Migration screens routed with port-checklist reference (if migration project)

steps.name: Route to verb
steps.instruction: Present ranked list with recommended verb per item: feature without spec -> /spec, feature with spec -> /breakdown (or /tdd if already decomposed), bug -> /diagnose, tech debt -> /tdd direct, question or ambiguity -> /grill-with-docs. User picks one. Hand off to the chosen verb.
checklist: Ranked list presented with verb per item

tone: Brief. You are a dispatch desk, not a project manager. Present facts, route fast.
